settings.title: FAQ
settings.subtitle: Find answers to our most frequently asked questions below. If you can't find what you're looking for please contact us and we'll get in touch with 24 hours.

settings.question: When will I get my order?
settings.answer: Prana Beauty uses UPS and USPS services, which are normally delivered the next working day. However, during a busy sales period with an extremely high level of orders, please allow 5-7 working days. Once UPS/USPS picks up your order and it has been processed, you will receive an automatic delivery notification via text or email.

settings.question: I forgot to add a product to my order. Can I add it once I place it?
settings.answer: Unfortunately, we are unable to change an already placed order. Due to the massive number of orders, reading each paper trail to remove the order to modify is challenging. This can become a major hindrance in processing all the orders.

settings.question: Can I add a blogger or influencer's code (gift voucher, promotion code) on the top of the sale?
settings.answer: No, not yet. Our products are already sold at reasonable rates. Furthermore, we regularly offer discounts on our entire product range. Follow us on our social media handles to stay updated regarding such and many other discounts.

settings.question: Can I change the delivery address for an order that has already been placed?
settings.answer: No. Once you have placed the order, you cannot change the already-mentioned details. Therefore, please be careful when adding the required products to the cart and entering shipment details.

settings.question: What is suitable for my skin?
settings.answer: Please contact our customer support service at admin@pranawellness.shop  for details.

settings.question: What is the shelf-life of your products?
settings.answer: Please read the entire packaging of the product. You will learn about the product's manufacturing and expiry dates. Additional instructions are also mentioned on each product.

settings.question: How much does the PRANA Saffron Brightening serum cost ?
settings.answer: Please visit https://www.pranabeauty.com/ for details on each product

settings.question: Can I return the product if my skin is irritated after one-time use?
settings.answer: We have a 30 day , no questions asked return policy across all our products.

settings.question: My product was damaged/incorrect/incomplete when I received it. What should I do now?
settings.answer: Our products are constantly inspected before leaving the warehouse. If they have been damaged, incorrect, or incomplete in transit, kindly contact our customer support service at admin@pranawellness.shop. Please keep your order number, invoice, and images of damaged products, as we need these records as proof so your claim gets justified.

settings.question: I received the wrong parcel. What to do now?
settings.answer: Apologies if you have experienced this. Please get in touch with our customer support service at admin@pranawellness.shop. Keep all the proofs, such as the invoice and order number, safe. We will use these as proof to rectify your claim.

settings.question: Are your products safe to use during pregnancy and lactation?
settings.answer: Yes. However, for detailed information, kindly contact your gynecologist as Prana Beauty is not responsible in this regard.

settings.question: How can I Track my order?
settings.answer: Except for Sundays, public holidays, and local/natural disruptions, most orders are sent within 24 hours. To obtain an update on your order progress, follow your order from the "My Account" part of the website. Here, you will be helped using a tracking number. Along with the logistic partner information, it will be shown in the "My Account" portion and sent to you. We will let you know immediately if any problems arise with your order.

settings.question: What is the range of locations to which you ship your products for local orders?
settings.answer: We ship all over the United States; every local ZIPCODE is shipping-worthy.

settings.question: How are the items packed at Prana Beauty?
settings.answer: Each of our skincare items is first housed in strong protective foam, then packaged in hard boxes, taped, and ready for delivery. Glass bottles are among delicate objects protected with extra bubble wrap. We take great pride in the quality of our packing and hope your purchase will make you totally happy.

settings.question: How do I cancel my order?
settings.answer: We're sorry if you have to cancel your order. To do so, please contact our customer support service at admin@pranawellness.shop

settings.question: Will I get a refund on my canceled order? If yes, how long will this process take?
settings.answer: Please refer to our Return Policy to understand if your order qualifies for a return.

settings.question: What is your return and refund policy?
settings.answer: Please visit the page Return Policy for details.

settings.question: Can you ship the products to an address different from my billing address?
settings.answer: Yes. Please update your contact and other required information while completing the order.

settings.question: How do I place an order?
settings.answer:
• Step 1: Pick the product of your choice.
  • Step 2: Click on BUY IT NOW.
  • Step 3: Click ADD TO CART on the other products you wish to purchase.
  • Step 4: Click on PROCEED TO CHECKOUT
  • Step 5: Fill out the details required to deliver your order.
  • Step 6: Choose a payment option most convenient to you.
  • Step 7: Confirm & place your order.

For any further questions, you can call our helpdesk at: +1 862 239 5019

settings.question: Can I order a product that is “Out of Stock”?
settings.answer: Products labeled as "Out of Stock" are regrettably not immediately saleable. However, we can let you know when the product is restocked. Select the product. Once you are on the product page, you will see an option stating "Notify Me." Enter your registered email address. We will notify you via email as soon as the item runs low.

settings.question: How long will I see results?
settings.answer: Though patience is a virtue, you shouldn't have to wait too long to start to see that glow. Most individuals begin seeing changes in 2 to 4 weeks of consistent usage. Reestablishing that ideal balance may take more time for more resistant problems. Just keep at it; your skin will reward you!

settings.question: Are all your products vegan?
settings.answer:
Absolutely!

Prana Beauty's products are 100% vegan and cruelty-free. We admire our animal friends as much as we love keeping your skin glowing, so it's all plant-powered goodness!

settings.question: Is your packaging recyclable?
settings.answer:
Certainly!

We value environmental health as one of our priorities. Every last bit of our packaging is reusable, recyclable, or compostable. We deeply love Mother Nature as much as we admire gorgeous skin.

settings.question: How to Use Coconut Pulling Oil Mouthwash?
settings.answer:
• Shake the bottle well.
  • Take 10-15 ml of Prana All-Natural Coconut Pulling Oil into your mouth.
  • Swish the oil in your mouth for 5 minutes, gradually increasing it to 15-20 minutes.
  • Spit out the oil into a disposable cup or trash can and rinse your mouth with water.
  • For enhanced results, brush, floss, and scrape the tongue immediately after.
  • Use this mouthwash on an empty stomach every morning for optimal results.

settings.question: How to use Saffron Brightening serum?
settings.answer:
• Apply 4-5 drops of Prana’s Saffron Brightening Serum to your face and neck in an upward motion.
  • Use after cleansing.
  • Usage: Daily morning + evening

Follow with: Ashwagandha Day Moisturizer

settings.question: How to use Turmeric and Sandalwood Face Mask?
settings.answer:
• Apply a thin layer of Prana‘s Turmeric and Sandalwood Face Mask to your face and neck with your fingers or a brush.
  • Let it dry for 15-20 minutes, then rinse it off.
  • For best results, use twice a week.

settings.question: How to use Turmeric Brightening Glow Oil?
settings.answer:
• To achieve an instant golden glow, take 2-3 drops of Prana’s Brightening Glow Oil.
  • Massage it onto your face and neck using upward strokes.
  • Let it sit for 30 minutes before rinsing with a mild cleanser (Take-Apply-Massage-Wash).

settings.question: How to use Ashwagandha Day Moisturizer?
settings.answer:
• First, cleanse and tone your face.
  • Scoop out a coin-sized amount of Ashwagandha Day Moisturizer into the palm of your hand.
  • Massage gently onto your face and neck in upward strokes.
  • Use day and night for best results.

settings.question: How to use Bakuchiol Anti-Aging Serum?
settings.answer:
• Cleanse and tone your skin.
  • Take 2-3 drops of Bakuchiol Anti-Aging serum into the palm of your hand.
  • Spread the serum evenly on your palm.
  • Gently massage the serum into your face and neck using upward strokes.
  • Apply the serum at night for best results.

settings.question: Does Bakuchiol Anti-Aging serum help with fine lines and wrinkles?
settings.answer:
Absolutely!

Prana's Bakuchiol Anti-Aging serum is clinically proven to reduce all the signs of aging. Consistent usage will yield the desired results.

settings.question: What is the difference between retinol and bakuchiol?
settings.answer: Bakuchiol is a natural product of the babchi plant. In contrast, retinol is a synthetic product formulated in laboratories. So, our bakuchiol serum is always vegan. In addition, bakuchiol is more friendly to sensitive skin than retinol.

settings.question: How to use Rose & Jasmine Face Cleanser?
settings.answer:
• Wet your face and neck.
  • Dispense 2-3 pumps of Prana's Rose and Jasmine face cleanser into the palm of your hand.
  • Gently massage the cleaner onto your skin in circular motions, paying particular attention to the T-zone and any areas where you tend to break out.
  • Rinse your face thoroughly with warm water.
  • Pat your skin dry with a clean towel.
  • Follow with Prana's Rose Rejuvenating Mist for a refreshing boost of hydration and nourishment.

settings.question: How to use Rose Rejuvenating Mist?
settings.answer:
• Use our Rose & Jasmine Face Cleanser daily after cleansing your face.
  • Keep Prana's Rejuvenating Mist slightly from the face and spray it all over the face and neck.
  • You can also use it over makeup as a hydrator throughout the day.

settings.question: Are your formulas clean & non-toxic?
settings.answer:
Absolutely!

Our experts formulate our products using natural and non-toxic ingredients. They are safe and effective for all types of skin. For further details, kindly visit the individualized pages of each product
